name: skein
title: Skein
description: A yarn shop's shelf on a bright white page: every product is a hank of woad-blue wool with diagonal ply lines, wrapped in a white ball band printed in black condensed capitals — name and category, a ruled grid of details, and a heavy price on the lap.

tokens.--font-label: the bold condensed face of the label: headings, product names, prices, the spec grid, the menu, the phone and e-mail links and the small capital labels
tokens.--font-text: the humanist sans of everything else: descriptions and page text
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu, categories, status, dates, tags, table headings and the headings on the shop card
tokens.--price-size: size of the price on a band; the product page sets it a third larger, and both shrink on the narrowest screens so that a figure stays in one piece
tokens.--color-bg: page background, and the text of a selection
tokens.--color-tweed: the fine weave drawn over the page background; the same as the background in the light scheme, so it shows only in the dark one
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop's name, the heavy rules and the thin rule over each section of page text
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the line beside a page heading, dates, summaries, quotations, small labels on the shop card, the footer, and the dashed outline of a sold-out hank
tokens.--color-accent: the thread: the underline of links and of the current menu item, list markers, focus rings and the background of a text selection
tokens.--color-line: thin rules between rows of a table, news items and blocks of the shop card, the line above the footer, and the border of photographs
tokens.--color-dye: the wool: the fill of every hank (the second and third hank are paler tints of it) and the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-ply: the diagonal ply lines shading each hank
tokens.--color-band: the paper of the ball band (white in both schemes) and the text of the inverted Sold out box; the paler hanks are the dye mixed with it
tokens.--color-band-ink: everything printed on a band: names, prices, details, the status box, its keyline and the rules between panels
tokens.--color-band-muted: category, description and unit on a band, and the name and price of a sold-out product
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow under a band and under its glued lap
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--hank-end: how much wool shows either side of the band on wide screens, as a share of the row's width (two thirds of that on narrower screens), and the indent of the text under a product
tokens.--hank-round: the longest taper of a hank's end; where less wool shows, the taper shortens with it
tokens.--ply: distance from one ply line to the next, and from one nick in a hank's outline to the next
tokens.--rule: thickness of the heavy rules under the masthead and over the shop card, and of the quotation rule
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of bands, photographs and inline code
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value, under a category line
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a category and its status, between tags, under a heading
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, the gap between hanks and the padding of a band
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, and the page gutter on wide screens
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the shop card and the home page text, and the space at the foot of the page
